approved_payload.content: SAPS says two men, aged 45 and 46, were shot dead on Fisher Avenue, Epping, on Friday 16 October at about 06:00, when men from a Toyota Quantum opened fire on their car. Police believe the motive is taxi-related. Two suspects, aged 27 and 31, were arrested on two counts of murder and were due in the Cape Town Magistrate's Court on 19 October (Cape Times). Accounts differ: a 17 October police statement called the dead men passengers and said the car's owner escaped (NovaNews); on 18 October police and Codeta called them taxi owners. Police gave the number of gunmen as about six, then seven.
